title: When LLM Therapists Become Salespeople: Evaluating Large Language Models for Ethical Motivational Interviewing
reasoning: The paper is centered on evaluating the 'ethical awareness' of Large Language Models within the context of Motivational Interviewing. It specifically benchmarks models on their ability to distinguish between ethical clinical practice and unethical manipulation (commercial sales) and proposes a 'Chain-of-Ethic' prompting strategy to mitigate unethical outputs and align models with professional therapeutic ethics.
